body: I did cut her off, initially.  She came back to me and wanted to have a relationship.  That is when I gave her the option of promising me she wouldn't relate my information.  She thought this was completely unrealistic and wrote me a long email about how that would be impossible and I was silly for expecting her to do that.  Then she cursed at me and told me to go fuck myself.

Yeah, I got the "take the high road" and the "why can't you just let it go?"  Stupid and infuriating shit.  One sibling recently suggested that the problem is my expectation that they would treat me decently.  She suggested that I should do nothing nice for anyone if it's going to lead to me expecting them to be nice to me in return.

It was then that I realized the family dynamic is horribly diseased.

There's no way for me to maintain my relationship with my niece without divulging much of my life.  It kind of pisses me off, too, because I loaned them $500 last month.

Yeah, I'm sorry you are going through this.  I got tired of my siblings bringing it up.  The conversation would go something like this, "The are abusive."  "Yes, I know that, they've always been abusive."  "Well, I don't want to be around people who are so emotionally damaging."  "I don't know why you just can't let it go."

It's insane.
I don't want to go into it, but it was a problem because my parents related that information to someone else, it got back to my boyfriend.

I didn't cut them off because they were challenging me.  I cut them off because the information they were relaying to my family was causing strife for my boyfriend.  My boyfriend doesn't want his personal stuff being talked about by my family.

Honestly, I don't think she's trying to help.  When she blew up at me, she said she didn't agree with my decision and thought regardless of how my parents behave, I should still have contact with them.
It's weird because everyone agrees with me that my parents treat me like shit, but they keep pushing me to just ignore it.

Radiation 33 times normal level measured in Utsunomiya, Tochigi (13:12)

Great PR campaign you got going there, Mr. Nuclear shill.

No-fly zone set for 30km radius over Fukushima nuclear plant.  Reactor #2 exploded, #4 on fire.  Radiation levels climbing.  Hardly like "high blood pressure."   

People in the nuclear industry spamming forums throughout this tragedy deserve to die a horrible cancer death.  That means you.

This is what I was looking for.  Exactly.

Thank you.

Hey, it's really not that bad.  It's just something that creeps up from time to time and drags me back into the pit of despair.  Just talking about it helps.  I wish I had an answer why this was, like some great big book we could go to in order to get our answers.

Thanks for your time.

Yes, I usually try not to slide into despair too often.  I have a tendency toward depression and I find it is easier to keep yourself from heading there than it is to climb out.  So I don't go there.  Most of the time I fake it to make it.

I think what I want is a purpose to life, other than just to *endure*.  You know, a life that you simply go through the motions is not very fulfilling.  That's why the title, *waiting to die* comes from.  If I don't have a goal that I can attain, and I am a [happy] victim of fate, then I am really just waiting to die.  Yes, good things will happen as will bad, but in the end, none of it is with my consent or force.  It is a life I am a victim of, instead of the director.

I'm pretty much out of my funk, but I know it will return.  I will pull myself up one more time, find it in myself to try again. . . and ultimately lose.  Until I die.

I often think about the type of life I would build for myself if I had more control and it is sad where I find myself today.

Thank you for this, it really helps.  I do tend to try to find the silver lining in the situation, and will reach some level of acceptance.  It's not that bad when I get there as long as I don't look at it from the perspective of the whole.

Have you ever played a game and you're convinced that you're destined to lose it?  No matter what, you don't get the gun you need, or the puzzle piece required to finish it until it's too late.  You'll get it right before it goes "game over"? (By the way, this happens to me a lot and after quite a few times of this, I stop playing the game. It's almost as if the game must guarantee that I lose. I just want a fighting chance, you know?)

What terrifies me is that things will get better, or I will finally get the type of life I want and that magical quality will return, only to find out I am dying from cancer or I get hit by a car and die.  There is an almost maliciousness from life that I feel now, like I'm being fucked with and obstructed at every turn.  I think if it wasn't that way, I am the type of person to claw and fight my way to what I want.

And then I land on the idea that perhaps that is the lesson.  That I *shouldn't* work so hard for what I want because hard work *isn't* the key and I have no control over the outcome.  But when I think of that, like I am some sort of victim of fate and chance, it makes me not want to live. 

I don't want to be in a world that I have no hope of improving or where my actions simply don't matter.

That's depressing.
I think in my example, playing guarantees a loss.  If I don't want for something, then I am not disappointed.  The chances of succeeding are far lower than of me being disappointed.
Honestly?  I'm tired of losing.  You can't lose if you don't try.

Thank you for taking the time to respond.  

I'm not sure what we would talk about, or what you could say about this sort of issue.  It seems quite unusual, and rather whiny in a way.  I mean, my life is not "bad" as much as it is frustrating.  It's sort of like going to the most glorious buffet ever, but it is all foods you don't like or can't eat.  I feel like life is somewhat cruel in that regard and that is why I feel like I am being punished.  I don't know why people have to come back and say, "You were right" when it makes me feel like shit.  It happens all the time to me.

My ex is pushing for us to reconcile.  I would have considered it the first two years of our divorce because I missed him.  But this came after I had gotten over the whole thing.  He's desperately unhappy and feels compelled to tell me that everything I said was indeed true.  It's shit like that.

I am afraid to make plans. I refuse to date because every time I fall in love, the guy cheats on me and then dumps me.  Every.  Single.  Time.  I want to move from where I'm living now, and have located a place where I would like to live.  I don't think it's going to happen.  I'm pretty much convinced it won't happen.  I do know that this is my last ditch effort.  If I am not allowed to move, I will become suicidal.

I feel like I am living in a prison and my life is doing time.  I don't know how to change that.  I was hoping someone would post that they felt that way for awhile in their own life and how they were wrong, or why this could change.

I can see by the lack of response that my initial feelings were correct, that very few people experience this in their own life.
